$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Folder trust settings: which folders an agent may start in without the trust question (acpmux trust_auto.rs). The acpmux daemon embeds this file (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/trust_auto.rs) and takes the defaults from it; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: trust
lists.note: Settings > Agents > Folder Trust: folders that need no trust question. The daemon reads the file at each check, so a change applies at once. An explicit Don't trust still wins. Off by default with empty lists: nobody's folders are trusted by a rule until the person turns it on and names their own roots and owners.

rows.name: trustAutoTrust
rows.note: Off: every folder without an answer asks, whatever the project roots and organizations below say.

title.text: Trust My Own Folders Without Asking

help.text: Agents start in folders under your project roots, and in repositories owned by your organizations, without asking. Other folders ask first.

rows.name: trustProjectRoots
rows.note: Folders whose contents are trusted without a question: absolute or ~/ paths. Symlinks are resolved first, so a link out of a root is not trusted.

help.text: Everything inside these folders is trusted. Use full paths or ~/ paths.

rows.name: trustOwnOrgs
rows.note: GitHub users and organizations whose repositories are trusted without a question. Every remote of the repository must belong to one of them.

help.text: A repository is trusted when all of its GitHub remotes belong to these users or organizations.
